title: ctx registry descriptor
description: Served by a registry at /.well-known/ctx-registry.json. Everything in it is public; it tells a client how to reach the registry and grants nothing by itself.

oauth.description: Google OAuth client of type 'Desktop app', used by the CLI for the loopback sign-in flow. The secret of a desktop client is not confidential.

api.description: Base URL of the publish API, without a trailing slash and including the version segment, for example https://registry.example.dev/v1.

endpoints.description: Overrides of the Google service base URLs. Only for emulators and tests; a production registry leaves this out.

oidcAudience.description: Audience a CI job must request for its OIDC token when publishing.
